scope.mode: READ-ONLY capture: no process killed/suspended, no registry write, nothing created/modified/deleted outside the 3 report files

methodology.processEnumeration: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process (WMI CIM) with one Select-Object projection, no duplicate property names
methodology.windowEnumeration: Add-Type C# P/Invoke: EnumWindows + GetWindowTextW/GetWindowTextLengthW + GetClassNameW + GetWindowThreadProcessId + IsWindowVisible + IsWindowEnabled + IsIconic + GetWindowLongPtrW(GWL_EXSTYLE=-20 / GWL_STYLE=-16) + GetWindowRect + GetWindow(GW_OWNER=4) + GetParent + GetForegroundWindow
methodology.correlation: window.pid -> process.ProcessId; EnumWindows returns top-level windows only (including invisible ones, which are reported with visible=false)
methodology.ownershipRule: never classify by process name alone: require image-path prefix, and/or command line + ancestry. Name-only matches that cannot be resolved to a path are reported as name-token-only-unresolved, never as legacy.
methodology.auditSelfMatchControl: any process whose ancestor chain contains the DSH harness (dsh-subprocess-local / @deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js) or whose ancestor powershell command line contains EnumWindows is marked inAuditHarnessSubtree and excluded from legacy classification, because this audit command text literally contains MateEngineX / airi / build\pet\app
methodology.knownLimitation: Win32_Process CommandLine and ExecutablePath may be null for protected/other-user processes; per-process executablePathReadable/commandLineReadable record that
methodology.history: v1 of this capture listed ExecutablePath twice in Select-Object, which silently dropped some process objects; v2 fixed it; v3 (this file) also fixes interpreter-hosted legacy scripts being mislabeled and adds the related-process tree

commands: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, ExecutablePath, CommandLine, CreationDate, SessionId, ThreadCount, HandleCount, WorkingSetSize, PageFileUsage, KernelModeTime, UserModeTime, Priority

integrity.note: Get-Process count is sampled a moment later than the CIM query; a small delta can be ordinary process churn, not data loss
